paper_title: (Almost) Closing the $ν$MSM Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Window with NuSTAR
coupling_convention: sin^2(2 theta), dimensionless sterile-neutrino mixing angle squared (as plotted on y-axis)
notes: This paper sets limits on sterile neutrino dark matter (nuMSM) via X-ray line search with NuSTAR, constraining the sterile-active mixing angle sin^2(2theta) vs sterile neutrino mass (10-50 keV) and the decay rate Gamma vs mass. Neither the mixing angle nor sterile neutrino decay corresponds to any of the available coupling types (axion, dark photon, scalar, vector B-L, etc.), so coupling_type is null and no data points are emitted. Local DM density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3, coreNFW profile default. Limits are one-sided 95% C.L. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 8 (fig_04) is the exclusion plot; the red 'NuSTAR GC (2016)' curve is the lower boundary of the excluded region. y-axis is sterile-neutrino mixing sin^2(2theta) (10^-15 to ~3e-10), x-axis m_chi in keV (~4-50 keV, only 10^1 tick labeled). This coupling (sterile-neutrino mixing angle) is NOT among the allowed coupling_type list, so coupling_type is null. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3, coreNFW default profile, one-sided 95% C.L. Curve has strong fluctuations at high mass (background lines) and 'bump' deteriorations near 13 keV and 40 keV due to iron line / background transitions. Values read from log-log plot; high-mass points are noisy approximations. The same curve appears over a wider range in Fig. 1 (fig_01). | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=1.67 snapped to identity)
